mentions.name: ToolScaled
mentions.description: This agent and workflow builder converts chats with Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or any other chat agent into a workflow or autonomous agent. It is aimed at AI-assisted development, helping users manage their time and parallelize work without switching between chat sessions.
mentions.problem: In modern AI-assisted development, the key challenge is managing your own time and parallelizing work without having to switch between chat sessions as much as possible.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been working on building an agent and workflow builder that converts chats with claude, chatgpt, gemini or any other chat agent into a workflow or autonomous agent. Its live at toolscaled.com
mentions.author: biggestriverman
